description: Synthetic sesslint.session.v1 schema parity. Header, event, and framed bytes come from to_canonical_json. Flat bytes come from dump_canonical format json. No session payload from a real transcript is stored.
known_parity_gaps: dump_session and dump_canonical format jsonl return a header line plus one line per event. That byte string is not one JSON document, so it is not expected output.
format date-time is an annotation under the pinned draft 2020-12 schema. RFC 3339 checks in canonical.py are not applied.
The dataclass emitters omit optional None fields. JSON null for title, version, source, execution_state, and nullable event strings is schema-valid and is not an emitter document.
get_session_schema_path and load_session_schema open a file. validate_session_json does not.
A root oneOf failure reports oneOf. required, const, enum, type, minimum, minLength, and additionalProperties rows use the header, event, flat, or framed subschema.
Rust reprints emitter documents. It does not reimplement internal source-key stripping.
